2026-11-24.headline: Claude Code adds cloud Code Mode, Codex links threads, and Devin updates MCP and sessions
bullets: Claude Code 2.1.331 adds Code Mode support in terminal sessions on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry, and Claude Platform on AWS.
Codex CLI 0.172.0 lets you follow thread links from search results and transcripts to open saved conversations and nested agents in the terminal.
Devin adds split-pane sessions via Option/Alt+click, moves session search to Cmd/Ctrl+K, and adds Run now to the Automations right-click menu.
Devin now lets you allow an MCP tool for a whole session, binds API-key MCP headers to secrets, and defaults custom MCP servers to Automatic authentication.

2026-11-25.headline: Codex extends free Sites hosting; Claude Code adds MCP skills
bullets: Codex extended free Sites hosting through January 31, 2027, with overage billing for Plus, Pro, and Business plans starting February 1, 2027.
Codex plans to display Sites hosting usage in-app starting January 1, 2027, and updated pricing tables with credit tiers.
Claude Code 2.1.332 added beta support for skills from MCP servers, appearing as server:skill in the / menu.
